title: Robust Checkpoint Selection for Multimodal LLMs via Agentic Evaluation and Stability-Aware Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2605.18852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Selecting a final checkpoint for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is challenging when late-stage candidates are closely matched and downstream evaluation signals are noisy. Small observed differences can be comparable to variability introduced by finite evaluation samples, LLM-based judges, and ambiguous multimodal evidence, while validation loss may not identify the checkpoint preferred by downstream evaluation. We formulate late-stage checkpoint selection as a stability-aware decision problem under evaluation uncertainty and propose a progressive framework combining pointwise filtering, listwise ranking, and pairwise refinement. Repeated evaluation-set subsampling is used to characterize ranking stability, while percentile-based aggregation accounts for lower- and upper-tail behavior. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型的鲁棒检查点选择：基于代理评估与稳定性感知排序
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.18852v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：当后期候选检查点表现相近且下游评估信号存在噪声时，为多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）选择最终检查点具有挑战性。小的观测差异可能与有限评估样本、基于LLM的评判者以及模糊的多模态证据引入的变异性相当，而验证损失可能无法识别下游评估偏好的检查点。我们将后期检查点选择形式化为评估不确定性下的稳定性感知决策问题，并提出一个结合点式过滤、列表式排序和成对细化的渐进框架。通过重复的评估集子采样来表征排序稳定性，而基于百分位的聚合则考虑了低尾和高尾行为。实验表明，多模态数据的可评估性至关重要：对OCR密集型输入进行质量感知的筛选可将排序翻转率降低。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合点式过滤、列表式排序和成对细化的渐进框架，通过子采样评估和百分位聚合处理评估不确定性，实现多模态大语言模型检查点的鲁棒选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a progressive framework combining pointwise filtering, listwise ranking, and pairwise refinement with subsampling and percentile-based aggregation to robustly select checkpoints for multimodal LLMs under evaluation uncertainty.
